sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Energy / Thermal Coal · Indonesia. PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk engages in the coal mining activities. The company is also involved in the logistics business, which includes coal barging and transshipment, fuel oil transportation and management, river channel management and dredging, multipurpose terminal and stockpile management, stevedoring, and shipyard operations. In addition, it engages in construction, operation, and maintenance of drinking water supply system; mine water pumping and processing operations; water treatment and water solution…
